_README: Cards that exist for the playtest but are not in the workbook yet.
WRITTEN BY HAND, like rules.json and playtest_level.json. export_data.py
never overwrites it. DataDB appends these to the workbook's cards after
loading, so every existing path treats them as ordinary cards: they are
looked up the same way, dealt the same way, and a Starter-tier one joins
EMPTY ON PURPOSE. It held one card, PT_C01 'Don't Engage', which passed
the round for a gaffe. Playtesting found it pointless: ending a turn
without playing anything already passed the round and cost nothing, so
the card was strictly worse than the button next to it. Passing is now a
rule rather than a card - ending a turn having played nothing costs an
energy next turn, and in a press conference declines the question - so
the card had nothing left to do.
The pipeline is kept, and proven, for whatever card comes next. When one
here earns its place it should move into the Cards tab of the workbook
and be deleted from this file, so the workbook stays the source of truth.
The shape of a row is every column cards.json has. The two the workbook
computes with formulas - power_score and power_per_cost - should be left
null rather than guessed; nothing in the game reads them.
